focus: جلسه دوازدهم · حال ساده در برابر آینده قطعی

sentences.fa: مادرت چش شده؟ چرا داد مي زنه؟
sentences.en: What's wrong with your mother? Why is she shouting?

sentences.fa: چرا داد و بيداد مي کنه؟
sentences.en: Why is she yelling and shouting?

sentences.fa: چيزي شده؟ کاسه اي زير نيم کاسه هست.
sentences.en: Is anything wrong? I smell a rat.

sentences.fa: کاسه اي زير نيم کاسه هست.(آمريکايي)
دست و پام خواب مي ره.
sentences.en: I have got pins and nails in my hands.
I have got a cramp in my back.
I have got a frog in my throat.
I have got a cold, what shall I do?
Why don't you see a doctor?

sentences.fa: چرا يسري به دندانپزشک نمي زني؟
sentences.en: Why don't you see a dentist?

sentences.fa: چرا يسري به دامپزشک نمي زني؟
sentences.en: Why don't you see a vet?
Why don't you take a tablet?
Why don't you take an aspirin?

sentences.fa: چرا مشکلت رو توي جلسه مطرح نمي کني؟
sentences.en: Why don't you bring up your problem at the meeting?
I don't know any good doctor.
Are you coming to the party tonight?

sentences.fa: کجا بيام؟ اونجا کسي رو نمي شناسم.
sentences.en: Where shall I come? I don't know anybody there.

sentences.fa: شما اينجا کسي رو مي شناسي؟
ينفر اينجا من رو مي شناسه.
اينجا رو مثل کف دستم مي شناسم.
sentences.en: I know here like the back of my hand.

sentences.fa: چرا از صاحب خونت نمي پرسي؟
sentences.en: Why don't you ask your land lady?
Why don't you ask your neighbor?

sentences.fa: چرا از همسايه بغليت نمي پرسي؟
sentences.en: Why don't you ask your next door neighbor?

sentences.fa: فکر خوبيه، بعداً ازشون مي پرسم.
sentences.en: That's a good idea, I am asking them later.

proverb.fa: يه سيب در روز از پزشک دورت مي کنه.
proverb.en: An apple a day keeps the doctor away.

conversation: B: I have got a cold.
A: Why dont you s'ee a doctor?
B: I don't know any doctor.
A: Why don't you ask your land lady?
B: Yes, that's a good idea.
